meta.description: Faiz Fayez imports and exports premium dry fruits and fresh fruits, trading between India and markets across the Middle East, Asia and Europe. Request a quote today.

hero.title: Premium Dry Fruits & Fresh Fruits, Traded Across Borders
hero.text: We import quality nuts and dried fruits into India and export India’s finest fresh produce to buyers in the Middle East, Asia and Europe, with sourcing, grading, paperwork and freight handled end to end.

about.title: A Trusted Name in Dry Fruit & Fresh Fruit Trade
about.lead: Faiz Fayez is an import and export company specialising in dry fruits and fresh fruits. We supply wholesalers, retailers, food manufacturers and distributors in India and overseas.
about.text: We bring premium almonds, pistachios, walnuts, dates and raisins into India, and export Indian mangoes, pomegranates, grapes and cashews to markets across the Middle East, Asia and Europe.
points: Direct sourcing from growers and processors
Every lot sorted, graded and quality checked
Bulk and custom packing to buyer specification

services.title: Complete Trade Services, From Sourcing to Delivery
services.text: One partner for the whole shipment: buying, quality control, packing, paperwork and freight.

items.title: Import to India
items.text: Almonds, pistachios, walnuts, dates, raisins, figs and apricots from Afghanistan, Iran, the USA and the Gulf.

items.title: Export from India
items.text: Mangoes, pomegranates, grapes, apples, kinnow and cashews shipped to buyers in the Gulf, Asia and Europe.

items.title: Sourcing
items.text: We find the right grade, origin and price for your requirement and share samples before you commit.

items.title: Quality Control
items.text: Size grading, moisture and visual checks on every lot, with photos and reports before dispatch.

items.title: Packing & Storage
items.text: Bulk cartons, vacuum packs or private-label packing, with cold storage for fresh produce.

items.title: Documentation & Logistics
items.text: Invoices, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificates, customs clearance and freight by sea, air or road.

process.title: From Inquiry to Delivery in Five Steps

steps.title: Inquiry
steps.text: Share the product, grade, quantity, packing and destination port.

steps.title: Quote & Samples
steps.text: We send a clear quotation and samples or lot photos for approval.

steps.title: Quality Check
steps.text: The approved lot is graded, inspected and packed to your specification.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.text: Invoices, certificates and customs paperwork are prepared and shared.

steps.title: Shipment
steps.text: Goods are dispatched by sea, air or road, with tracking until delivery.

items.title: Consistent Quality
items.text: The grade in the sample is the grade in the shipment.

items.title: Transparent Pricing
items.text: Clear quotations with no hidden charges.

items.title: Reliable Timelines
items.text: Shipments planned and dispatched on the dates we commit to.

items.title: Compliance Handled
items.text: Import and export paperwork prepared correctly, first time.

items.title: Strong Network
items.text: Established partners at origin and in destination markets.

items.title: Long-Term Relationships
items.text: Many of our buyers return season after season.

certifications.title: Registered and Compliant
certifications.text: Add your licences and registrations here, such as IEC, FSSAI or APEDA, with their numbers or certificate images.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity?
items.a: Minimum quantities depend on the product and destination. Send us your requirement and we will confirm what is possible.

items.q: Can I get samples before placing an order?
items.a: Yes. We can share samples or detailed lot photos so you can approve the quality before shipment.

items.q: Which countries do you ship to?
items.a: We trade mainly between India and the Middle East, South and South-East Asia, Europe and the Americas. Contact us about other destinations.

items.q: Do you offer private-label or custom packing?
items.a: Yes. We pack in bulk cartons, vacuum packs or retail packs with your branding, to your specification.

items.q: How do I request a quotation?
items.a: Use the inquiry form below or message us on WhatsApp with the product, grade, quantity and delivery port.

partnership.title: Partner With Faiz Fayez
partnership.text: We are looking for distributors, wholesalers, retail chains, food manufacturers and overseas importers for long-term supply partnerships, bulk contracts and private-label packing.
